description: This file defines a class 'ProxyGrain' implementing the 'IProxyGrain' interface, which manages a proxy to another grain in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes methods for creating the proxy and retrieving runtime identifiers.

classes.name: ProxyGrain
classes.description: A grain class that proxies requests to another grain identified by a key, providing runtime identification features.

methods.name: CreateProxy
methods.description: Initializes the proxy grain reference with a specified key.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of this grain instance.

methods.name: GetProxyRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime identity of the proxied grain.
